fields.summary: TC-MTA-004: Market Time Adjustment - Last Trip Original Leg Delayed More Than 15 Minutes with Later Trip End Generates LCO-P

content.text: Linked Story: Market Time Adjustment
Precondition: A crew member has an original last leg of the trip assigned in V0. The leg is delayed by more than 15 minutes resulting in a later trip end time. isOriginal = TRUE initially.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with an original last leg of the trip on flight 456 DAL-MCO in V0
Flight 456 DAL-MCO, isOriginal=TRUE, leg position=Last leg of trip, plannedArrTime=18:00, V0
Original last trip leg is set up successfully in V0
Apply a market time adjustment delay of more than 15 minutes to the last leg resulting in a later trip end time
Delay > 15 minutes, newArrTime=18:20, new trip end is later than original planned trip end, changeType=Market Time Adjustment
Market time adjustment is applied resulting in a later trip end time
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the last leg is treated as Non-Original after more than 15-minute delay
isOriginal flag in COA record for the last leg
isOriginal = FALSE. Delay of more than 15 minutes changes original status to Non-Original.
Verify the trip end boundary is impacted and LCO-P is generated for this last leg
LCO field in COA record for the last leg
LCO-P is generated. Later trip end on a last original leg with more than 15-minute delay triggers LCO-P.
